name: TechSupportWifiDropout_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which require technical support.

initial_prompt: Create a conversation in which two people troubleshoot a laptop that will not connect to the home wifi, working through the obvious fixes before deciding whether to keep going or fall back to a cable.

variations.context: A laptop that will not join the home wifi

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners, one more technical than the other
setting.background: The laptop connected fine yesterday; other devices still work

scenario_template.topic: The laptop will not connect to the home network
scenario_template.note: It worked yesterday, which makes it more annoying. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Other devices connect fine, so it is not the router
scenario_template.note: They rule things out one at a time. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: What to try next after restarting everything
scenario_template.note: The obvious fixes are already exhausted. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Working through adapter and driver settings
scenario_template.note: Step-by-step, one change at a time. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Whether it is worth more time or just use a cable
scenario_template.note: They disagree about how long to keep going. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Checking the fix holds after a reboot
scenario_template.note: They test it properly before declaring victory. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Noting what to do if it recurs
scenario_template.note: They agree on a fallback for next time. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to solve a technical problem but has limited technical experience and can become overwhelmed when faced with unfamiliar terminology, multiple troubleshooting steps, or complex configuration choices.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help diagnose and resolve technical issues, but tends to overthink possible causes, double-check troubleshooting steps, and seek confirmation before making unfamiliar system or configuration changes.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
